name: Gutenito Gutenberg Blocks – Website Builder for the Block Editor
author: Eunito

sections.description: Gutenito blocks addon and templates library for Gutenberg.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gutenito-blocks-addon directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress

sections.changelog:
0.0.5

  • Added: Blockquote block – Stylized quotation display component
  • Added: Buttons block – Interactive button elements with various styles
  • Added: Call-to-Action block – Promotional component for driving user engagement
  • Added: Content Timeline block – Visual timeline display for chronological content
  • Added: Countdown block – Dynamic countdown timer component
  • Added: Counter block – Animated numerical counter with increment animation
  • Added: FAQ block – Accordion-style frequently asked questions component
  • Added: Form block – Customizable form builder with input fields
  • Added: Google Maps block – Embedded interactive map component
  • Added: How-To block – Step-by-step instructional guide component
  • Added: Icon List block – List component with icon prefixes
  • Added: Image Gallery block – Grid-based image display component
  • Added: Info Box block – Highlighted information container
  • Added: Inline Notice block – Contextual notification or alert component
  • Added: Lottie Animation block – JSON-based animation player
  • Added: Marketing Button block – Conversion-focused button component
  • Added: Modal block – Popup/overlay dialog component
  • Added: Post Carousel block – Rotating post display slider
  • Added: Post Grid block – Grid layout for post listings
  • Added: Post Timeline block – Timeline view for posts
  • Added: Price List block – Menu or pricing table component
  • Added: Review block – User review and rating display
  • Added: Separator block – Visual divider component
  • Added: Slider block – Image or content carousel
  • Added: Social Share block – Social media sharing buttons
  • Added: Star Ratings block – Visual rating display component
  • Added: Table of Contents block – Automatic content navigation generator
  • Added: Tabs block – Tabbed content organizer
  • Added: Video Popup block – Lightbox-style video player

0.0.4

  • Fixed: Compatiability issue with WordPress 6.9

0.0.3

  • Fixed: Responsive control issue

0.0.2

  • New: Templates library
  • New: Responsive controls
  • New: Margin and padding controls
  • Improved: Color controls in the editor

0.0.1

  • Initial Release
